sources.citation: E. Paquette, P. Poulin, G. Drettakis, Surface aging by impacts, Graphics Interface 2001: wear concentrates on exposed convex edges

the documented mesh-map encodings, consulted, never copied: the curvature map is mid grey on flat surfaces, brighter on convex and darker on concave ones; the ambient occlusion map is white where unoccluded; the position map holds the bounding-box-normalised position per axis; the world space normal map holds n x 0.5 + 0.5; the thickness map is brighter where the mesh is thicker
K. Perlin, Improving noise, ACM Transactions on Graphics 21(3), SIGGRAPH 2002

D. S. Ebert, F. K. Musgrave, D. Peachey, K. Perlin, S. Worley, Texturing and Modeling: A Procedural Approach, 3rd ed., Morgan Kaufmann, 2003, chapter 2 (Peachey: the clamp, boxstep linear ramp and smoothstep 3t^2 - 2t^3 building blocks) and chapter 16 (Musgrave: fractional Brownian motion)
R. C. Gonzalez, R. E. Woods, Digital Image Processing, 4th ed., Pearson, 2018, chapter 9 (grey-scale dilation and erosion by a flat structuring element)
